theorem residue_form_gen {α Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx α a q Q) {y₁ y₂ : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y₁) (hlen : y₂ - y₁ ≤ q) (hy₂ : y₂ ≤ Q / 2) (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΦ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Φ x) :
    ∃ τ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ R, τ R ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) ∧
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋,
          (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) ≤
        ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (q - 1), Φ (Real.sin (π * (R + τ R) / q) ^ 2) :=

note: The main-range total still holds (at least ≈0.24% to spare). Erratum: For C < B sin(π/q) the proof's majorant X already exceeds the right side of (4.6) near C = B sin(π/2q) (ratio 1.0696 at q = 140, above 1 for every q ≤ 400 except q = 3), and the printed relaxation to C = B sin(π/q) gives the factor 3 + log((q/π)sin(π/q)) ≥ 2.548, so the range C ≤ Bπ/(eq), where (4.6) claims the factor 2, is not proved (checked by `scripts/checks/lemma_4_1_3.py`).
